info.title: Fernando Compliance Accelerator API
info.description: REST API for the Fernando Compliance Accelerator (FCA) platform. Errors use RFC 9457 problem+json with a stable `code`. Cross-framework mappings and assessments are informative aids and do not constitute legal advice.

path.description: Dot-notation path of the offending field, e.g. `address.country`.

message.description: Human-readable explanation. Safe to show but not stable: branch on `code`.

title.description: Short, human-readable summary of the HTTP status.

detail.description: Human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence.

code.description: Stable machine-readable error code. Clients branch on this.

requestId.description: Correlation id, also returned in the `X-Request-Id` response header.

password.description: At least 12 characters, not a very common password, not containing the email name.

accepted.description: Always true: the request was accepted, whatever the state of the account.

token.description: The one-time token from the link in the email (the part after `#token=`).

accessToken.description: Short-lived access token. Keep it in memory; send it as `Authorization: Bearer`.

expiresInSeconds.description: Seconds until the access token expires.

token.description: The one-time token from the link in the email (the part after `#token=`).

password.description: The new password (same rules as registration).

emailVerified.description: False until the address was confirmed; unverified accounts cannot sign in.

isPlatformAdmin.description: True for a platform administrator (may use `/platform/*`; that alone gives no access to any organisation's data).

timezone.description: IANA time zone (for example `Africa/Harare`). Deadlines and reminders are computed in this zone.

Permission.description: Everything the role may do (the permission catalogue). The UI uses it to show or hide actions; the API enforces it regardless.

permissions.description: Everything the role may do (the permission catalogue). The UI uses it to show or hide actions; the API enforces it regardless.

id.description: The membership id (use it in the member routes).

joinedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC instant the person joined.

version.description: Send it back unchanged with every change: a stale value is rejected with 409 `VERSION_CONFLICT`.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `after` to get the next page; null on the last page.

version.description: The `version` of the member as last read.
The `version` of the member as last read.

assigned.description: False until a platform administrator assigns a plan.

maxUsers.description: Null = unlimited, and also null while no plan is assigned.
